collection.title: Daimler Super Eight 2005 to 2009 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Daimler Super Eight 2005 - 2009 model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
